# Preface {.unnumbered}

This is the onboarding tutorial for the `robotics` example package. It covers the
day-to-day fundamentals of working in this codebase — Python environments and
imports, project structure, debugging, version control, NumPy/PyTorch tensor
work, and the robotics concepts (kinematics, rotations, simulators, IK) that the
`src/robotics/` library illustrates.

The tutorial is split into short, self-contained chapters so sections can be
edited and reviewed independently. Use the sidebar to navigate.

## How to use it

- The runnable examples live in `scripts/` and the library in `src/robotics/`.
  Set the environment up once with `uv sync`, then run any example with
  `uv run python scripts/<name>.py`.
- Code blocks in these pages are illustrative snippets; the authoritative,
  runnable versions are the files under `scripts/` and `src/`.
- **Progress:** each major section (`##` heading) has a **Done** checkbox. Your
  choices are saved in this browser only (`localStorage`). Unread sections are
  highlighted in the page table of contents; the left sidebar shows chapter
  status (blue = not finished, orange = partly done, ✓ = all sections on that
  chapter marked done).

## Building these docs

```bash
uv sync                 # project env (numpy, einops)
quarto preview docs     # live-reloading local preview
quarto render docs      # build static HTML into docs/_site
```
